free_tier.stated: Six days of VPS free, activated automatically once the balance is topped up, with the deposit staying on the balance afterwards for any order or transfer to another account. The amount is stated as RUB 300 in the body of the trial page and as RUB 200 twice in the same page's questions, and the promotions page says RUB 300 for a VPS and RUB 100 for shared hosting, so the provider publishes three numbers for one deposit. Ports 25 and 465 are closed until the trial is converted to a paid order, and on tariffs from KVMz-PROF upward the test needs support approval. The cheapest paid shape is advertised from RUB 169 a month, with European and non-CIS locations sold from the same catalogue.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: At RUB 169 a month this is the cheapest 24/7 machine found in this category, and the deposit composes with the trial: RUB 300 covers nearly two months of the floor plan after the six free days, so the first paid month is already funded by money that was never a fee.

limits.value: The deposit is the gate and the closed mail ports are the design constraint: six days of a machine that cannot send mail is a web-hosting trial rather than a server trial, and the RUB 169 floor plan is sized for a site, not for a transfer workload.
